name: flip-words
title: Flip Words
blurb: Words cycle with staggered letter entry and exit animations.
description: Cycles through a list of words with letters and sub-words animating in staggered fashion. Each word's letters blur and fade in, then the entire word blurs out and scales up before the next word appears.
use_when: Inline word swaps with engaging entrance/exit choreography, like in taglines or feature lists.
avoid_when: When word list changes frequently or readability is paramount.
a11y: Current word is fully rendered and readable; animations are visual transitions.
